column1: # The BMD-4M was photographed head-on at an exhibition with a tarpaulin over
# the turret and a cover bagged over the barrel. Three of the card's four cues
# are about that turret — the 100 mm and 30 mm barrels together, and the turret
# looking oversized for the hull carrying it — so none of them could be seen.
# This is a three-quarter view with the turret exposed: both barrels visible,
# all five roadwheels countable along the short airborne hull, whole vehicle in
# frame. Rejected several alternatives where soldiers stood in front of the
# hull, which is the same fault wearing different clothes.
